summary: No dossier sell trigger tripped. Kinsale's Q3 combined ratio was 75.4% but premiums fell 4.8% and a CFO transition was announced (WATCH). Deckers cut its FY27 sales guide on slowing Hoka and Ugg and fell ~8% after hours, still well above MOS. Meta's New Mexico penalty is unconfirmed. The chip-equipment sell-off is price noise (METHOD 7).
